searchText: Yes, see pinned message Where can I find tooling for offline 0x02 credential and consolidation generation? I don't want to have to connect my withdrawal address to the launchpad. You could use this 🙂 https://github.com/sigp/siren/ *if you run lighthouse 😉 <@144468805697929216> does ethereal work for offline consolidation tooling? Seems counterintuitive to set up a beacon node on an offline-only machine. I don't see much detail about this in the Lighthouse Book. Can it generate the signed messages and allow you to copy them to an online machine for broadcast using ethereal? ah got it, seems like ethereal might be what you need then. You can provide it a source and target validator or privkey. I havent tried out the offline approach though. ethereal → <https://github.com/wealdtech/ethereal> `ethereal` doesn't need to be online to operate, but you'll need to supply it with additional information if offline, such as the account nonce you want to use in the transaction. Where can I find the fork digest for electra mainnet? I found `0xad532ceb` on the logs of the node but I wanted to confirm if this was the correct one
